newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: YPF share sale price to be announced at 1330 GMT.
newsitem.headline: YPF share sale price to be announced at 1330 GMT.

text.p: The cut-off price for the sale of 10 percent of shares in Argentine oil firm YPF will be announced Wednesday at 1030 local/1330 GMT, said a source from Banco Comafi, one of the underwriters.
"The cut-off price will be announced at 1030 local time," the source told Reuters. "The deal goes ahead normally."

An Argentine judge modified late Tuesday an earlier ruling and allowed the sale of the 10 percent of YPF shares that are in the hands of the company's employees, after YPF made a deposit of $400,000 in guarantees to the court.
Merchant Bankers Asociados, an Argentine affiliate of Salomon Brothers Inc, Salomon Brothers and U.S. firm Vestrust are also underwriters of the deal.
